木_食神.catalyst: As a catalyst, the growth stays low to the ground. What you let out is small and warm, and it seldom reaches past the people nearest you.
木_食神.friction: As a friction, the current spreads wide and shallow. Your strength drains away into pleasant hours, because each day has to feel good.

木_伤官.catalyst: As a catalyst, the growth comes in bursts. A bold idea breaks through hard, and then the ground lies quiet for a while.
木_伤官.friction: As a friction, the current runs loud. Each word leaves at full force for the rush of it and costs more than it brings.

catalyst.tail: As a catalyst, the growth runs short. Your warmth and your boldest ideas reach people early, and little comes after to carry them further.

friction.tail: As a friction, the gate never gets to close. You spend yourself on how the moment feels, and little is left over for later.

balanced_tail: In balance, the gate opens at your pace. Your warmth and your ideas take root and grow, and enough stays inside to feed what comes next.

advise_catalyst.text: What you let out comes in bursts, and the slow work in between stays hidden. Give the thing you made to someone before you think it is finished. Tell one person about a plan you have kept quiet. Read one page you wrote to a friend. Send the text without rereading it.

advise_friction.text: Seek Metal, the Mind energy. Metal is the cold side water forms on. It pulls from the air and hands the water back to its source. Let it hold what Wood pours out. Nothing you let out will fill you back up. Read one whole chapter before you make the next thing. Let one question sit overnight.

火_偏财.catalyst: As a catalyst, the warmth runs short and travels in sparks rather than a steady glow. What reaches people comes in bright, scattered bursts.
火_偏财.friction: As a friction, the light runs ahead of its fuel. The next thing makes you feel alive, and what you already have burns down behind you.

火_正财.catalyst: As a catalyst, what little warmth there is gets guarded close. It reaches a few people and stays with them.
火_正财.friction: As a friction, each bright chance lands like a threat. Your need to feel secure keeps you braced against the heat until it wears you out.

catalyst.tail: As a catalyst, the warmth runs short, and you want a far chance as much as steady pay. You lose most on what you leave unclaimed.

friction.tail: As a friction, the light burns through its fuel. Gain and loss fill your whole mind, and little of you is left to rest.

balanced_tail: In balance, the fire burns steady. New ground and old ground both get your warmth, and it reaches the people you provide for.

advise_catalyst.text: Most of your chances are lost by never being claimed, not by failing. Put a date on one venture and begin before it arrives. Ask for the raise instead of waiting for it. Tell the person you love what you want next. Once a week, buy the small thing you keep pricing.

advise_friction.text: Seek Water, your own Body energy. Water is the deep you draw from, the sleep and food and slow fill that come before anything is lit. Let it hold what Fire burns. Whether you are reaching for more or guarding what you have, the heat comes out of your own reserves. Keep one night a week unlit, in bed early. Eat before you say yes to anything.

土_七杀.catalyst: As a catalyst, the frame runs thin, and it firms up only when the stakes rise.
土_七杀.friction: As a friction, the frame presses in. Needing to be ready for the worst, you carry the strain long past the danger.

土_正官.catalyst: As a catalyst, the frame runs thin. The few lines you live by are ones you drew yourself.
土_正官.friction: As a friction, the frame decides for you. You need to feel on solid ground, and your own judgement goes unused.

catalyst.tail: As a catalyst, the frame runs thin. Little structure comes from outside, and you supply the rest from your own will.

friction.tail: As a friction, the frame closes in. You need to stand right with the rules, and that leaves you little room of your own.

balanced_tail: In balance, the frame holds without closing in. You keep the rules you chose and stand easy inside them.

advise_catalyst.text: You carry every line you live by alone, since few deadlines come to you from outside. Put yourself under one. Sign up for the race, the exam or the course with a date on it. Tell one person above you what you will deliver and when. Keep one standing rule at home, the same sleep hour every night. Pay one bill the day it arrives.

advise_friction.text: Seek Metal, the Mind energy. Metal is the clear line that sorts a demand into what is asked and what is feared. Let it hold what Earth presses on you. You take each demand as a judgement on yourself. Before your next big yes, ask one person who has made the same call, and write down what they say. Then sleep on it.

金_偏印.catalyst: As a catalyst, what flows in runs short and is weighed piece by piece. Little gets in by accident.
金_偏印.friction: As a friction, the test runs on past its use. Your need for certainty costs you whole days of proving what is already proved.

金_正印.catalyst: As a catalyst, shelter comes in small measure. You are drawn to the few places that feel safe and settle deep in them.
金_正印.friction: As a friction, shelter piles up around you. Cover feels like safety to you, and you spend years under a roof you have outgrown.

catalyst.tail: As a catalyst, little flows in from outside. What does reach you is held close and goes deep.

friction.tail: As a friction, the test never ends. Nothing feels safe to you until it is right, and making sure eats the hours you meant for living.

balanced_tail: In balance, the test is quick and fair. What passes it settles in, and you trust it enough to use it.

advise_catalyst.text: You let in less than the world has to offer, and the gap shows when a question needs more than you hold. Keep one book going that is harder than you need. Ask someone older how they did it, and hear them out to the end. Sleep on any answer that matters. Write the question down before you reply.

advise_friction.text: Seek Fire, the Action energy. Fire melts what has gone hard, so a checked thought becomes an act and the extra look burns off. Let it spend what Metal stores. Each extra round of care buys you safety and costs you a move. Ship one piece as a draft you would accept from others. Decide one small thing with no second look.

水_比肩.catalyst: Running thin, the well is shallow. You draw from it with care, and little is spilt or shared.
水_比肩.friction: Running over, the depth fills with no way out. Needing nobody feels safest to you, but the weight then builds up where no one can help carry it.

水_劫财.catalyst: Running thin, the well is shallow. Other people's energy fills it faster than rest does.
水_劫财.friction: Running over, the depth churns with no outlet. You need to prove yourself among friends, and the drive gives you little rest.

catalyst.tail: Running thin, the well is shallow. Each effort draws on what little you hold, and the bottom comes early.

friction.tail: Running over, the depth has no outlet. Your strength and your wants pile up inside, and you carry more than anyone near you ever sees.

balanced_tail: In balance, the tide goes out and comes back in. You spend and refill in turn, and your strength holds.

advise_catalyst.text: Every push you make draws on a reserve that was small to begin with. Take in before you spend. Sleep a full night ahead of any decision that matters, and let one peer carry half of a shared task. Ask a friend for the whole answer rather than guessing it. Eat lunch sitting down.
